verdict.rationale: Decagon explicitly ships 'Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs)' described as letting teams 'define agent behavior in natural language, the same way you train human agents with SOPs,' with Duet auto-generating and iterating these procedures from real interactions. This directly matches encoding step-by-step SOPs for known issue types. Missing for 10: concrete technical detail on how branching logic/decision trees are structured and enforced deterministically, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
